title: Modular Ackermann maps and hierarchical structures
summary: We introduce and study modular truncations of the Ackermann function, formalized as discrete dynamical trajectories on the set of least non-negative residues. These maps form a hierarchy of rapidly increasing compositional complexity indexed by recursion depth. We investigate their structural properties, sensitivity to depth variation, and the induced distributions modulo powers of two.
